briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and xAI Colossus-3 accelerate multi-agent capabilities as race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 11 new models this month with escalating capability jumps. Compute buildout continues at record pace while regulatory frameworks lag. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed Orion-2 with 4x agentic reasoning gains. Anthropic's Claude 4.5 and Google's Gemini 3.0 Pro launched within 72 hours. xAI Colossus-3 achieved top scores on new multi-agent benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New vulnerabilities reported in agent orchestration layers. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 1.2M Blackwell GPUs this quarter. Microsoft and Oracle announced joint 200MW AI data center expansions in Texas and Singapore.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards emerge before state actors weaponize open-weight models at scale?
